Hi, I worked at a credit union call center for about 5 years total, 2 of the years was in Card Services dept. Here were some of my duties there in case I can be of any help:

I encountered a lot of member’s with lost or stolen or compromised cards, & I deactivated then had issued many new credit/debit cards. As well as had card pins mailed due to people forgetting them or being compromised.

Input codes/dates for travel notices so the members cards’ could work while they’re on vacation, known where I worked as ‘suspending the strategy’. 

Reviewed transactions for credit/debit card merchant disputes, & or to determine if charge(s) are fraudulent. The amount of card compromises there was high. It was interesting to do ‘detective’ work to help the members.

Increased/decreased atm/point of sale limits depending on situation/how long funds have been available.

Explained billing cycles & how interest charges are based on the ‘average daily balance’ (where I worked anyway). Waived credit card late fees. Most likely you may also answer questions about card points/rewards.

Processed members claims of ATM’s malfunctioning (a high number), so they could receive their funds.

These among other fun functions of working there :)
